global_attrs.solver: steady neutral ABL, Arakawa-C FVM, transported k-epsilon (torch)

time_note: valid_time is the literal clock decoded from each file; the files do not state a time zone

w.staggered_from: zf -> z layer centres (mean adjacent interfaces)

icing_index.long_name: icing risk index = supercooled_fraction(T) x normalized cll

icing_accum.long_name: accumulated ice accretion thickness = E*LWC*U/rho_ice x dt

precip.long_name: precipitation rate (region-mean constrained, redistributed by 3D-wind moisture convergence)

cloud.long_name: cloud (region-mean constrained, redistributed by 3D-wind vertical motion, z=0-8000m)

cloud_low.long_name: cloud_low (region-mean constrained, redistributed by 3D-wind vertical motion, z=0-2000m)

risk_level.long_name: number of exceeded low-level hazard thresholds
